name: श्रीरामः
meaning: He who delights all beings — the beloved Lord.

name: रामभद्रः
meaning: The auspicious one, bringer of all good.

name: रामचन्द्रः
meaning: Cool and gentle as the moon to those who behold him.

name: शाश्वतः
meaning: The eternal one, unchanging across ages.

name: राजीवलोचनः
meaning: Whose eyes are wide and lustrous as lotus petals.

name: श्रीमान्
meaning: Endowed with grace, dignity, and divine splendour.

name: राजेन्द्रः
meaning: Lord of kings — sovereign among rulers.

name: रघुपुङ्गवः
meaning: The foremost of the Raghu lineage.

name: जानकीवल्लभः
meaning: Beloved of Janaki — devoted husband of Sita.

name: जैत्रः
meaning: The ever-victorious one.

name: जितामित्रः
meaning: Conqueror of every foe.

name: जनार्दनः
meaning: Refuge of all souls — to whom prayers ascend.

name: विश्वामित्रप्रियः
meaning: Dear to the sage Vishvamitra, his first guru.

name: दान्तः
meaning: Perfectly self-controlled, master of the senses.

name: शरणत्राणतत्परः
meaning: Ever-eager to protect those who take refuge in him.

name: वाली​प्रमथनः
meaning: Slayer of Vali — restorer of dharma in Kishkindha.

name: वागमी
meaning: Eloquent of speech — whose words carry truth.

name: सत्यवाक्
meaning: Whose every word is truth.

name: सत्यविक्रमः
meaning: Whose valour rests on truth alone.

name: सत्यव्रतः
meaning: Steadfast in the vow of truth.

name: व्रतपरायणः
meaning: Devoted to every sacred vow he undertakes.

name: सदा हनुमदाश्रितः
meaning: Forever attended by Hanuman, his greatest devotee.

name: कौसलेयः
meaning: Son of Kausalya — beloved firstborn of the queen.

name: खरध्वंसी
meaning: Slayer of the rakshasa Khara at Janasthana.

name: विराधवधपण्डितः
meaning: Skilled vanquisher of the demon Viradha.

name: विभीषणपरित्राता
meaning: Protector of Vibhishana, granting him refuge and a throne.

name: हरकोदण्डखण्डनः
meaning: Breaker of Shiva's mighty bow at Mithila.

name: सप्ततालप्रभेत्ता
meaning: Whose single arrow pierced the seven sala trees.

name: दशग्रीवशिरोहरः
meaning: Slayer of ten-headed Ravana.

name: जामदग्न्यमहादर्पदलनः
meaning: Humbler of Parashurama's pride.

name: ताटकान्तकः
meaning: Destroyer of the demoness Tataka.

name: वेदान्तसारः
meaning: The very essence of all Vedanta.

name: वेदात्मा
meaning: The soul of the Vedas themselves.

name: भवरोगस्य भेषजम्
meaning: The medicine that cures the disease of worldly existence.

name: दूषणत्रिशिरोहन्ता
meaning: Slayer of the rakshasas Dushana and Trishira.

name: त्रिमूर्तिः
meaning: Embodiment of the three forms — Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva.

name: त्रिगुणात्मकः
meaning: He whose nature transcends the three gunas.

name: त्रिविक्रमः
meaning: Who measured the universe in three strides.

name: त्रिलोकात्मा
meaning: Soul of the three worlds.

name: पुण्यचारित्रकीर्तनः
meaning: Whose sacred life-story purifies all who hear it.

name: त्रिलोकरक्षकः
meaning: Protector of all three worlds.

name: धन्वी
meaning: The supreme archer.

name: दण्डकारण्यवासकृत्
meaning: Who dwelt long in the Dandaka forest during exile.

name: अहल्याशापशमनः
meaning: Who lifted the curse of Ahalya by the touch of his foot.

name: पितृभक्तः
meaning: The model son — devoted to his father Dasharatha.

name: वरप्रदः
meaning: Bestower of boons to those who pray to him.

name: जितेन्द्रियः
meaning: Master of the senses.

name: जितक्रोधः
meaning: Conqueror of anger — ever serene.

name: जितामित्रः
meaning: Vanquisher of every adversary.

name: जगद्गुरुः
meaning: Teacher of the entire universe.

name: ऋक्षवानरसङ्घाती
meaning: Who gathered the armies of bears and vanaras.

name: चित्रकूटसमाश्रयः
meaning: Who took refuge at Chitrakuta during exile.

name: जयन्तत्राणवरदः
meaning: Who pardoned Jayanta the crow with merciful boon.

name: सुमित्रापुत्रसेवितः
meaning: Served devotedly by Sumitra's son Lakshmana.

name: सर्वदेवादिदेवः
meaning: The God of all gods.

name: मृतवानरजीवनः
meaning: Restorer of life to the fallen vanaras after the great war.

name: मायामारीचहन्ता
meaning: Slayer of Maricha disguised as the golden deer.

name: महादेवः
meaning: The great divinity.

name: महाभुजः
meaning: Mighty-armed warrior.

name: सर्वदेवस्तुतः
meaning: Praised by every god in heaven.

name: सौम्यः
meaning: Gentle, gracious, soft-natured.

name: ब्रह्मण्यः
meaning: Friend of the brahmins, upholder of dharma.

name: मुनिसंस्तुतः
meaning: Hymned by the sages.

name: महायोगी
meaning: The great yogi.

name: महोदारः
meaning: Boundlessly generous.

name: सुग्रीवेप्सितराज्यदः
meaning: Who restored Sugriva's longed-for kingdom.

name: सर्वपुण्याधिकफलः
meaning: Whose remembrance yields the fruit of every sacred act.

name: स्मृतसर्वाघनाशनः
meaning: Whose mere memory destroys every sin.

name: आदिपुरुषः
meaning: The primal person — first of all beings.

name: महापुरुषः
meaning: The supreme person.

name: परम्पुरुषः
meaning: The transcendent self.

name: पुण्योदयः
meaning: The rising sun of all merit.

name: दयासारः
meaning: Essence of compassion itself.

name: पुराणपुरुषोत्तमः
meaning: The ancient supreme person of the Puranas.

name: स्मितवक्त्रः
meaning: Whose face wears a gentle smile.

name: मितभाषी
meaning: Whose speech is measured and never wasted.

name: पूर्वभाषी
meaning: Who speaks first, never waiting for another to greet him.

name: राघवः
meaning: Descendant of King Raghu.

name: अनन्तगुणगम्भीरः
meaning: Of endless virtues, profound beyond fathoming.

name: धीरोदात्तगुणोत्तरः
meaning: The heroic and high-minded one, supreme in virtue.

name: मायामानुषचारित्रः
meaning: Whose human form is itself a divine līlā.

name: महादेवादिपूजितः
meaning: Worshipped by Mahadeva himself.

name: सेतुकृत्
meaning: Builder of the bridge to Lanka.

name: जितवाराशिः
meaning: Conqueror of the ocean itself.

name: सर्वतीर्थमयः
meaning: He in whom all sacred waters dwell.

name: हरिः
meaning: Who removes sorrow and bondage.

name: श्यामाङ्गः
meaning: Of dark, rain-cloud-blue complexion.

name: सुन्दरः
meaning: Beautiful beyond measure.

name: शूरः
meaning: The brave one, fearless in battle.

name: पीतवासाः
meaning: Clad in golden-yellow silks.

name: धनुर्धरः
meaning: Bearer of the bow — the eternal archer.

name: सर्वयज्ञाधिपः
meaning: Lord of every sacrifice.

name: यज्वा
meaning: The sacrificer — performer of holy rites.

name: जरामरणवर्जितः
meaning: Beyond old age and death.

name: विभीषणप्रतिष्ठाता
meaning: Who installed Vibhishana on the throne of Lanka.

name: सर्वावगुणवर्जितः
meaning: Free of every fault and impurity.

name: परमात्मा
meaning: The supreme Self.

name: परम्ब्रह्म
meaning: The transcendent absolute.

name: सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः
meaning: Embodied form of being, consciousness, and bliss.

name: परम्ज्योतिः
meaning: The supreme effulgent light.

name: परंधाम
meaning: The highest abode of all souls.

name: पराकाशः
meaning: The infinite space beyond space.

name: परात्परः
meaning: Greater than the greatest.

name: परेशः
meaning: The supreme Lord.

name: पारगः
meaning: Who has reached the far shore of all knowledge.

name: पारः
meaning: The far shore itself — the goal of all yogis.

name: सर्वदेवात्मकः
meaning: In whom every god is contained.

name: परः
meaning: The transcendent one — beyond all.
